title: TP: pulse timer
summary: TP produces a pulse of fixed length PT on a rising edge of IN, regardless of how long IN stays TRUE.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.body:
- A rising edge of **IN** starts a pulse: **Q** becomes TRUE.
- Q stays TRUE for exactly **PT**, even if IN goes FALSE earlier.
- While the pulse runs, further edges of IN are ignored.
- After the pulse, ET is held at PT until IN goes FALSE, then resets.

sections.heading: Typical use
sections.body: A fixed-length horn signal, a defined dosing time for a valve, or a lubrication pulse.

instruction.state: Instance holds pulse start and state.
instruction.timing: Evaluated once per call; resolution equals the cycle time in PLC Lab.
